gen-vast-shadow-gf-anek-telugu: Anek Telugu leans on wide, tall bowls and rounds that never quite close, giving the text a loose, friendly gait. Vast Shadow is the loud one, thick horizontals and all; the sans just reads.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-anuphan: Anuphan builds its lowercase from big round bowls and open curves, while Vast Shadow above keeps every curve as thick as a drawn thread. Paragraphs in it flow smoothly.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-arimo: Vintage swagger comes first from Vast Shadow, every stroke cut with the steadiness of a technical pen. Arimo, a plain sans, does the quieter job of staying readable through its spacious, rounded openings.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-armata: Armata reads with generous gaps between characters and lowercase that fills most of the letter height, so the text feels open and current. And Vast Shadow's heading, with no thinning anywhere, would sit above paragraphs of it without ever crowding them.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-athiti: Athiti keeps its mean line high and every s open. Vast Shadow is built for attention, cut like sign-shop vinyl with one line width, while the plain sans body simply carries the words.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-atkinson-hyperlegible: Vintage and loud, Vast Shadow stamps its tall, evenly cut letters across the top, bowls as heavy as stems. And Atkinson Hyperlegible, a plain sans with wide-set terminals on s, sits beside it like a friendly, quiet neighbor.

Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono spaces its letters far apart, with open counters and capitals that feel clipped beside the lowercase. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono is the pair's quiet strength, set against Vast Shadow's pipe-like, vintage strokes.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-biryani: Biryani reads clearly, with a large eye on every e, no thick-and-thin modulation and small counters that never clog. Biryani gives Vast Shadow's tall, one-width vintage letters something plain to stand beside.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-blinker: Approachable is the first word for Blinker, whose lines hold their thickness and whose lowercase fills most of the height. Blinker can stay modest in size while Vast Shadow's vintage letters grab the eye above it.
gen-vast-shadow-gf-carrois-gothic: Modern and tidy, Carrois Gothic sets a high x-height and a generous opening in c, while Vast Shadow above has round letters with rims matching the stems. Paragraphs run smoothly.
